classification_contract.DELETE-SAFE_MERGED: not main; not protected; not an open PR head; exact tip SHA is an ancestor of baseline main; git rev-list baseline..tip == 0; tip != baseline main SHA
classification_contract.KEEP_OPEN_PR: branch is the head of at least one open pull request
classification_contract.REVIEW_UNMERGED: tip not fully contained in baseline main, or any uncertainty / extra-conservative hold

safety_notes: This manifest is read-only inventory. No branch or tag was deleted.
Phase 2 must re-validate name, SHA, open-PR status, protection, and ancestry immediately before any delete.
Any drift from this exact SHA mapping is STOP.
Open PR heads are never delete-safe.
Tip-equals-current-main is REVIEW_UNMERGED because a freshly created empty work branch is indistinguishable from a leftover at the same SHA.
